name: karaoke-maker-3000
description: Prepare, create and continue karaoke videos using your existing Karaoke Maker account.

defaultPrompt: Make karaoke with a snowy forest background and blue accents.
interface.longDescription: Prepare an MP3, review its current price and create a karaoke MP4 with instrumental audio, synced lyrics and a background. Continue the same Quick project or hand it to Studio for detailed correction. Uses your connected Karaoke Maker account and balance. File delivery depends on the host: selected local files use the scoped upload flow when local streaming is available.
